answer: The grader tests his glue with the finger, and the glue must string or it is too thin to hold a joint. Chime ash keg cooper oak bond is the testing: a bond ash keg coopers lodge after cooperage trials. The anchor is the first test, made at the pot; the trellis is the last, made before the staves are joined, and the thread is the pot itself, warm with glue. A cheat must test 41 false pots and join 41 false staves.
